input.summary: Ported softmax.cu to SYCL 2020 (migrated/softmax.dp.cpp). Compiles with icpx -fsycl and without the dpct include path; zero dpct:: helpers, DPCT_* macros, or <dpct/...> includes remain. Changes from the SYCLomatic output: plain sycl::malloc_device/queue/parallel_for with nd_range<1>; softMax2 uses sycl::sub_group with reduce_over_group (max/plus) and works for any sub-group size, since the kernel uses get_local_linear_range() rather than a hard-coded 32; the launch derives the slices-per-work-group from the device's sub_group_sizes; sycl::exp replaces native::exp for accuracy; the queue uses default_selector_v because the only device in this environment is an OpenCL CPU device (gpu_selector_v threw). Verification against a CPU double-precision reference (fill_input inputs) for both kernels: 8192x256, 1000x100, 333x37 all have max abs error <= 1.1e-7 (atol 1e-6 satisfied). Caveat: no GPU was available, so the run used the CPU OpenCL device; the original CUDA binary was not executed here, the reference is the CPU-computed softmax.
